Ponytail is installed as personal Cursor skills under `~/.cursor/skills/`. They apply in every project.

**Installed**

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `ponytail` | Lazy-senior mode: YAGNI → stdlib → native → one line |
| `ponytail-review` | Diff review for over-engineering |
| `ponytail-audit` | Whole-repo bloat audit |
| `ponytail-debt` | Harvest `ponytail:` shortcut comments |
| `ponytail-gain` | Benchmark impact scoreboard |
| `ponytail-help` | Command reference |

Start a **new chat** so Cursor picks them up.

The main skill is meant to auto-attach on coding work. You can also say `ponytail`, `be lazy`, or `/ponytail lite|full|ultra`. Default intensity is **full**. Say `stop ponytail` or `normal mode` to turn it off.
